_meta.purpose: Reviewed exceptions for lib/qa/migration-security-gate.ts. A blocking finding (WEAKENING or UNKNOWN) passes CI only when an entry here matches it EXACTLY: migration path, schema-qualified object, policy name (or null), rule, and the fingerprint of the statement itself.
rules: No wildcards anywhere. One entry excuses one statement in one file for one rule.
HISTORICAL_SUPERSEDED entries must name the later migration that fixed the condition, and the gate re-checks that the condition is really gone at the end of the replayed corpus.
CURRENT_INTENTIONAL entries must still describe something that exists; an entry whose subject disappeared is stale and fails.
An entry that matches no finding is stale and fails. Editing an excused statement changes its fingerprint, so the exception stops applying rather than following the edit.
_meta.internal_schemas_rule: Security statements on these schemas are judged as internal: policies and RLS there are recorded, but any grant of a table, schema or default privilege to anon/authenticated/public is still a blocking finding. A schema not listed here, and not public, fails closed.
